--link-length: 4;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->It's great to see sing-box is back. So far I liked it most. Its small and native and works, with no need for web stacks and huge Chromiums (Electron, CEF, ...) to just run proxies. Network Extensions and TUN are implemented perfectly without the need to mess with drivers or tangle with system proxy settings to pretend to be a global VPN. Also, some might like (beautiful) GUIs, I don't care or even not like that approach. Sing-box core itself is comprehensive enough, and trying to interpret everything with GUI fields will create a lot of textboxes to fill in, parsing from and into when importing/exporting, not to mention the fact that even detailed GUI fields cannot provide enough freedom as writing JSON configurations in many cases.<!-- HTML_TAG_END --></p> </div>  </div></div>  <dialog data-testid="dialog"
